The '''''High Roller''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] owned by an unknown [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]]. In [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], it attacked the ''[[Tradewyn]]'' in an attempt to capture [[Raynar Thul|Raynar]] and [[Aryn Dro Thul]]. The attack was unsuccessful and it was destroyed by a shot from [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]].
